title: Inside a Huge PCB Factory
summary: Strange Parts tours JLCPCB's large PCB factory in Huizhou, China, walking through the printed circuit board manufacturing process step by step. It shows the machinery, quality checks and scale behind cheap prototype boards.
why: Recommended as the best look inside a modern PCB fab, cited in threads on hobby PCB vendors, manufacturing in China and automation.

quote.text: It's a tour of JLCPCB's factory, where they go through all the PCB manufacturing steps.
